name: w05-3d-game-gourd-runner
description: Gourd Runner - a short browser-based 3D endless runner built with Three.js for the Week 05 group assignment.
notes: There are no runtime npm dependencies.
Three.js r147 is vendored at lib/three.min.js (MIT licence) so the game runs fully offline.
The game opens by double-clicking index.html; 'npm start' is only an optional local-server fallback.
No lockfile is included because no packages are installed.
